description: This file defines the SettingsScreen widget for a Flutter application, which displays a settings page allowing users to toggle chat features. It imports Flutter material components and provider for state management, referencing a SettingsController to manage the chatEnabled setting.

classes.name: SettingsScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget representing the settings screen, showing a toggle for enabling/disabling chat features.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the SettingsScreen, including an AppBar and a ListView with a SwitchListTile to toggle chat functionality.
